portInfo.description: Palacrociere is Savona’s cruise terminal. Its how-to-reach page publishes GPS coordinates and states the port sits in front of the historic centre with about a 5–10 minute walk to main attractions across a pedestrian bridge. The city has no airport; road access is via A6 (Turin) and A10 (Genoa/Ventimiglia).

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Historic centre walk — 5–10 min from terminal. ~60 min.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Use the pedestrian bridge route described by Palacrociere; photograph all-aboard before shopping streets.
